subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected-label PR be retired as superseded by the later macOS onboarding work, or should the contributor rebase it into a narrow follow-up?
rationale: Automation cannot close a `maintainer`-labeled PR, and deciding whether any remaining UX pieces are still wanted after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 is a maintainer product-direction call.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Treat the merged local Gateway bootstrap and Crestodian onboarding work as the canonical direction and invite a fresh narrow PR only for any remaining unsolved detail.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, remove replaced wizard/installer/probe changes, fix the listed blockers, and add macOS proof.

options.title: Adopt and repair this branch
options.body: A maintainer can sponsor the branch despite the overlap, but it needs security/auth fixes and real behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Treat the merged local Gateway bootstrap and Crestodian onboarding work as the canonical direction and invite a fresh narrow PR only for any remaining unsolved detail.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged overlapping macOS setup PRs and is the clearest owner for deciding whether this older branch still has wanted remnants.
